summary: Build sourcing plans, compare supplier costs, and improve bid evaluation. Explore this practical five-day strategic sourcing course.
lede: Strategic sourcing helps procurement officers, buyers, and contract professionals turn spend data and purchasing needs into documented sourcing decisions. The course covers spend categorisation with Excel and the Kraljic Matrix, total cost of ownership comparisons, structured RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes, and supplier evaluation and performance scorecards; it also introduces AI-assisted spend classification and its limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare sourcing decisions, run procurement processes, or review supplier performance and purchasing controls.
prerequisites: No formal procurement qualification is specified as a prerequisite. Basic familiarity with purchasing activity is useful; exercises use Excel and do not require coding or programming. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the spend-analysis exercise.
